newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc maintains EPS rise target.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc maintains EPS rise target.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc chairman Jean-Rene Fourtou said he was maintaining his objective of a 20 percent increase in earnings per share, before exceptionals, in 1997.
"Our priority remains to improve our profitability and to continue our debt reduction," Fourtou told a news conference.
He said that the results at Centeon would remain depressed at the start of the year and that the polyester activities would remain negative in the first quarter.

Earlier finance director Jean-Pierre Tirouflet said that the company's polyester unit in Brazil, responsible for a 500 million franc negative impact in 1996, was very well placed to benefit from a market upturn.
